short_summary: Found 12 candidate events across Pretoria/Centurion/Tshwane via web search; 8 cleared the 3-source non-resale verification bar and were published (3 Bulls URC home games at Loftus, Kip Moore Live, SA vs Bangladesh 2nd Test, Jill Scott concert, Irene Village Market, Pitori Kota Festival); 4 discarded for lacking independent non-resale corroboration or conflicting source details (Melkfest VI, ACCES 2026, Lekompo Fun Day, Afrikaans is Groot multi-date series).

Found 12 candidate events across Pretoria/Centurion/Tshwane via web search; 6 cleared the 3-source non-resale verification bar and were published (Francois van Coke & Vriende, Bulls vs Stade Francais Champions Cup, Ne-Yo Live in SA, The Ultimate R&B Experience Tour, Wonderboom Airshow, Irene Village Market 7 Nov); 6 discarded for lacking independent non-resale corroboration or conflicting source details (Lekompo Fun Day, Nickel Christmas Market, Randpark/Grove Mall Festive Market, Schweppes Pretoria Gin Festival, Comedy & Soul Festival, Fijnwyn duplicate date).

Found 15 candidate events across Pretoria/Centurion/Tshwane via web search; 4 cleared the 3-source non-resale verification bar and were published (Homecoming Africa 2026, Kloof Night Market, Melkfest VI, Afrikaans is Groot 2026 opening night); 11 discarded for lacking independent non-resale corroboration, conflicting dates/venues, or already being in the past (incl. All White Festival shows, Menlyn Maine Central Square Market, Irene Farm Night Market Nov date, ACCES Conference, Oktoberfest Pretoria, Ruhan du Toit at Atterbury with conflicting dates, and several already-past Sept 2026 events).

Found 14 candidate events across Pretoria/Centurion venues (markets, concerts, rugby, cricket, theatre); only Sean Paul (4 Dec), Brandy's two Pretoria shows (17-18 Dec) and the Mamelodi Sundowns vs USM Alger CAF Super Cup final (8 Nov) cleared the 3-source non-resale bar with online-confirmed dates. The rest (several markets, a candlelight concert, Bulls/SuperSport United fixtures, a Barnyard Theatre show, festive light switch-ons) were discarded for single-source, conflicting, or unconfirmed-year details.
Found 2 candidate events (Ramfest Halloween, Protea Menlyn Fire & Ice); neither could be corroborated by 3 independent non-resale sources, so nothing was published.
Found 2 candidates (Prime Circle at Railways Cafe 28 Nov; a December vintage and Christmas gift market); neither had 3 independent non-resale sources, so nothing was published.

Found 2 candidate events; the South Africa vs England Boxing Day 2nd Test at SuperSport Park, Centurion (26-30 Dec) cleared the 3-source non-resale bar and was published. A second Pretoria night (31 Oct) of the Ultimate R&B Experience Tour at SunBet Arena was discarded: only 2 independent non-resale sources could be machine-confirmed stating that date in isolation from the paired 30/31 October announcement.
